anchor: Plan v12 Q9 — industry operating-margin cross-validation against Damodaran NYU 'Operating and Net Margins by Sector (US)' January 2026 update + IRS SOI cross-check where relevant.
convention: verdict: 'match' (within ±5pp of canonical), 'minor_delta' (5-10pp), 'flag' (>10pp). Public-vs-SMB caveat noted per entry.
method: Damodaran's data is aggregated across PUBLIC companies (S&P 500 / Russell 3000) and is dominated by large incumbents. Atlas targets SMB-realistic margins, which run systematically lower for the same NAICS code. Verdicts therefore treat 'Atlas value <= Damodaran value' as the expected direction — we flag only when Atlas value EXCEEDS Damodaran (implausible for SMB) or undershoots by more than ~10pp (likely too pessimistic).
important_caveat: Damodaran's industry averages should be considered an UPPER BOUND for SMB margins. The right ground-truth source for SMB is IRS Statistics of Income (US) and NSO equivalents in other countries. Q9 batch 2 should expand to IRS SOI cross-validation for 5-10 representative industries.

restaurants.notes: SMB restaurant industry surveys (RPC, NRA) show median independent restaurant op margin 3-9%. Damodaran's 17.16% reflects chain operators (Chipotle 17.7%, McDonald's 45%). Our 10% is realistic for blended SMB independent + small-chain.

grocery_stores.notes: Our 4% slightly above Damodaran 2.55% (which is depressed by Kroger thin margins). FMI Grocery survey shows independent grocers 1-3% net, 3-5% operating. Our 4% reasonable.

hotels_lodging.notes: Damodaran 21.58% reflects Marriott/Hilton brand operators. Independent hotels per STR data run 12-22%. Our 18% is appropriate SMB midpoint.

trucking_freight.notes: Excellent match. ATA fleet surveys 5-9% op margin. Our 7% matches Damodaran exactly.

software_development.notes: Damodaran 40.81% dominated by hyperscalers (Microsoft 45%, Oracle 40%). SMB custom dev / agencies run 10-25% op margin. Our 20% is correctly SMB-calibrated; would be misleading to use Damodaran here.

residential_construction.notes: Damodaran 15.67% reflects construction supplies (Vulcan Materials, Eagle Materials) not residential builders. NAHB Cost-of-Doing-Business shows builders 6-12% op margin. Our 7% appropriate SMB residential builder.

clothing_stores.notes: Damodaran apparel includes branded retail (Lululemon 22%, Nike 12%). NRF data shows independent apparel 3-8%. Our 6% reasonable.

auto_repair_shops.notes: Damodaran 'Auto Parts' 6.37% is supplier industry (Magna, Lear), not service shops. AAIA shows independent repair shops 10-15% op margin (high labor markup vs parts). Our 12% in range.

next_batch_plan: Q9 batch 2: pull IRS SOI corporate margins for representative NAICS codes; that's the real SMB ground truth. Damodaran cross-checks ANY ambiguous case but is not the primary anchor for SMB.
